description: Chat and code edits with PersonAIly Hub's local and cloud models.
config.serverPath: Path of `app-server.exe`, the headless core the extension starts when the desktop app is closed. Empty: the one installed with the app, which the extension finds by itself.
config.dataDir: The app's data folder. Empty: the default one (`%APPDATA%\dev.personaily.hub`).
config.maxContextChars: Maximum characters of the open file sent as context. For longer files only the selection is sent.
config.inlineCompletion: Code suggestions while you type, from the local model loaded in the app (shown in grey, `Tab` accepts). It needs a code model trained for "fill-in-the-middle", such as Qwen2.5-Coder, and keeps the GPU busy while you write.
config.inlineCompletionDelay: Milliseconds to wait after the last key before asking for a suggestion.
